name: 01-dashboard
note: Dashboard entry: inspect result discoverability, recent activity and the operations snapshot. Default narrow viewport.
title: Dashboard

name: 02-script-library
note: Script discovery: source selector, filters, health counts, row actions and authoring review sessions.
title: Script library

name: 03-create-entry
note: Create script opens Use existing rather than Create. The next action is called Model; copy language says original unchanged until save, which may imply overwrite.
title: Create-script entry

name: 04-import-form
note: Import presents destination setup before the source file, plus an Agentforce-specific checkbox on generic OpenAPI flow. Validate and Convert disabled until a file is supplied; no conversion performed.
title: OpenAPI import

name: 05-expanded-script
note: Expanding Checkout HTTP changes pagination total from 27 to 28 although health-filter total stays 27. Detail rows appear to count as library items.
title: Expanded script

name: 06-script-editor
note: Library marks Checkout HTTP Ready 100; editor shows Validation evidence not yet, Debugged missing and Approval readiness needs evidence. Distinguish static validity from execution/approval readiness.
title: Script editor

name: 07-scenario-library
note: Scenario library shares table controls but has a wide set of default columns. Assess ability to find and act on a scenario at narrow width.
title: Empty scenario library

name: 08-scenario-start
note: Empty library creation offers Copy existing first despite no scenarios; five technical model choices precede script selection. Save draft is enabled on an untouched start.
title: Scenario start

name: 09-script-picker
note: Opening the picker pushes its table and surrounding content behind the sidebar at 923px. Focused search is visible far to the right; table geometry corroborates overflow. A future source-step warning appears early.
title: Scenario script picker

name: 10-run-settings
note: Guided VUser worksheet explains totals and phases clearly. Review compact layout and defaults; Run Settings is marked complete on first arrival.
title: Run settings

name: 11-data
note: Advancing to Data preserves a lower scroll position instead of revealing the new heading. Snapshot semantics are clear; disabled fields take space before a pool is selected.
title: Optional data

name: 12-scenario-validation
note: Model validation gives explicit capacity, data, placement, demand and runtime results. Save & Create Test Run coexists with text saying saving does not launch; clarify next step.
title: Model validation

name: 13-unsaved-dialog
note: Unsaved-change guard provides Keep editing, Discard and Save; initial focus lands on safe Keep editing. Draft is audit-only and will be discarded.
title: Unsaved-change dialog

name: 14-new-test
note: No scenarios available. Clear builder detour exists, but downstream run setup, scheduling and lengthy empty summary remain visible. No run was launched.
title: New Test prerequisites

name: 15-schedules
note: Recurring schedule defaults to UTC while one-off Scheduled Start uses America/New_York. Timezone is visible but defaults differ; use one explicit scheduling convention and show next occurrences.
title: Recurring schedules

name: 16-command-entry
note: Active-run selector includes duplicate names with identical statuses, with no date or reference to disambiguate them. Queued and Reserved are mixed under active.
title: Run selector

name: 17-reserved-run
note: Reserved run has Start Test, yet Current/Actual Load says 1 VU and reports zero errors/latency as values. Separate planned allocation from measured active load before execution.
title: Reserved run

name: 18-results
note: Completed results mix Complete/Failed lifecycle, assessment labels, and archive Pending; long-failed runs still say Pending without visible expiry/recovery explanation.
title: Results library

name: 19-report-summary
note: Summary correctly separates execution, acceptance and evidence. However nine samples, unknown termination/elapsed time and 1 peak VUser versus 22 planned merit a prominent insufficient-evidence conclusion above numeric KPIs.
title: Report summary

name: 20-baseline-compare
note: The selected baseline shows large latency/throughput/VUser deltas without an explicit comparability qualification for the current sparse run.
title: Baseline comparison

name: 21-evidence
note: Evidence exposes critical telemetry breaches and missing tiers, but summary only gives 85% coverage. Make critical quality warnings and recommended recovery prominent in Summary.
title: Evidence details

name: 22-export-preview
note: The light export document is intentional print presentation, not a dark-theme defect. It retains outcome/acceptance caveats and distinguishes transaction and request populations. No export was saved.
title: Export preview

name: 23-export-risks
note: Export Top Risks says no significant error patterns despite critical telemetry gaps and sparse samples; Business Impact is generic metric prose. Findings heading is empty.
title: Export risk narrative

name: 24-monitoring
note: Monitoring states deployment-wide health explicitly and distinguishes optional Kubernetes from blockers. Local auth bypass appears as an advisory.
title: Monitoring

name: 25-repository
note: Repository explicitly says its domain/project/release filters are independent of sidebar workspace. This is useful disclosure but adds a second scope model.
title: Repository

name: 26-access
note: Access combines global tabs, related-admin links, user subtabs, filters, wide table and a details panel. User row action cell is named Service account actions in DOM; verify screen-reader semantics.
title: Access

name: 27-admin-settings
note: Admin Settings provides search, grouped destinations, shared panel collapse, explicit deployment scope and restart-required labels. Narrow navigation adds a separate scroll region.
title: Admin Settings

name: 28-settings-search
note: Typing theme into Find settings yields No settings match even though Personal preferences contains Dashboard Theme. Search needs field names and synonyms, not destination titles alone.
title: Settings search

name: 29-user-settings
note: Non-admin Settings exposes appearance with browser-local persistence and no administrative form; matches shared visual language. Other sections require expanding navigation at narrow width.
title: User Settings

name: 30-user-admin-link
note: In User preview, Monitoring → Controller settings opens personal Appearance with no explanation and no visible return-to-monitoring control. Access is restricted, but the link promises the wrong destination.
title: User-to-admin link

name: 31-help-entry
note: Operator User Guide and Quick Start are nested under API Guide, whose default page leads with REST responses and dev headers. Rename/reorganize as Help & documentation with task-led entry.
title: Help entry

name: 32-import-wide
note: At 1440px, New script folder name uses a native gray 360×20px input while adjacent fields use theme styling. At 923px the same control stretches to a tall block. Keyboard Tab proceeds to Back.
title: Import at desktop width

name: 33-expanded-pagination-wide
note: Desktop reproduction: health filter All 27 but pagination Showing 1–10 of 28 after expanding one script. Expanded detail row consumes an item slot.
title: Expanded pagination at desktop width

name: 34-missing-archive
note: Failed jms-rel-run results open No archive available, with generic this run is complete and no run name/status/reference. Execution snapshot is the sole recovery action. Preserve identity/failure status and distinguish unavailable from pending archives.
title: Missing archive

name: 35-failed-snapshot
note: The snapshot recovery action initially opens Archive, whose visible panel contains only Archive Report. A publication-delay banner appears in the subsequent diagnostics view, so recovery is incomplete rather than wholly absent.
title: Execution snapshot fallback

name: 36-failed-diagnostics
note: Historical failed-run diagnostics retain Live Summary and Healthy telemetry labels; timestamp context is unclear and no failure cause is surfaced here. A delayed-publication banner appears, but the initial snapshot fallback landed on an empty Archive panel.
title: Failed-run diagnostics
